sources.text: Where where to find and start The Final Flush mission in GTA 6 and earn a stamina upgrade The Big Flush in GTA 6 is an optional mission, but it's well worth your time for a permanent stamina upgrade. You can start this GTA 6 mission from Chapter 1 onwards, and once it's done it's incredibly useful reward will allow you to do energy-draining activities, like running and swimming, for longer. It's also just a fun side mission to do. After finding an odd poster in a men's bathroom stall, you are enlisted to help oddball Dr. Merle to prove his bizarre conspiracy theory that the government is stealing DNA from poop (which is seemingly based on a real report about Putin ) and things only get stranger from there. To start The Final Flush mission in GTA 6, go to the bathroom block toward the north tip of Corsair Key in Mariana County (just north-east of Key Lento). It should be easy to find as it's the only building in Corsair Key. Enter the men's toilet and you'll see a handmade poster on the wall that says "Stop! Don't Flush. Scan to learn the truth #NOFLUSHERS" with a QR code attached. Use your WaiNK IT app to scan the code and you'll receive a message from an Automated Machine that tells you to reply "TRUTH" to join the No Flushers movement. Select the "Truth" reply and you'll receive another message telling you that whoever is messaging will be at Frank's Waffles in Vice City. If asked, you need to repeat the code: 00-00-02. You need to meet the mystery No Flusher at Frank's Waffles in the Tequesta neighborhood of Vice City, in Vice-Dale County. When you enter the waffle house, you'll find a man muttering to himself in one of the booths nearest the toilets. However, he seemingly won't appear if it's not night time, as, when I went during the day, the mission icon had a padlock on it and the man wasn't there. When you get near the man, he covers up whatever he's working on and tells you that he's holding a royal flush. When he asks do you have a "coda for that?," hold LT/LR while looking at the man to bring up the dialogue menu and select the code option with X/A. The oddball man is Dr. Merle, who quickly ingests a tracking device and begins waffling (no pun intended) about his conspiracy theory that the poop of Leonida citizens isn't actually going to the sewers but is instead going to a secret government DNA siphoning center. He then goes to the corporate-controlled bathroom to deposit the tracking device into the federally-controlled sewers, so you can track where Leonida's bowel movements go to the source of the whole operation. Once Dr Merle is done in the bathroom, follow him to his van outside. Follow his verbal directions to follow the tracker and it'll take you to the sewage treatment plant in Hamlet in Vice-Dale County. Follow the waypoint to park the van on the coast then follow Dr Merle on foot to the plant. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more When you reach the plant's fence, Dr. Merle begins unlocking a metal gate so that you can get inside and asks you to keep an eye out. Keep an eye on the road on the other side of the gate as a van will soon approach. If the driver stops and asks what you're doing, the best approach is to use the "Defuse" dialogue option to tell the worker you're simply fixing the gate. Once you're inside the sewage treatment plant ground, you're tasked with finding the tracker. The best approach is to head toward the area highlighted pink on your GTA 6 map until you see the two works chatting. Approach them and, when asked if you are electricians, use the "Lie" dialogue option to go along with their theory. Go through the open metal gate to the left of the works, then slightly right and you'll see a set of double doors. Enter these doors to enter the facility. Once you get inside Dr. Merle starts to freak out because the tracking device is apparently below your feet, but there's no obvious way to reach it, so he asks you to find a way down. Go up the metal stairs in this room and you'll find a control panel on the platform above. Select Triangle/Y to interact with the panel. To open the stairs that lead downstairs, all three lights on the left of the control panel need to be turned to green. So, push the buttons next to the two red lights (the middle and bottom ones), to turn them green, then tilt the main lever on the panel. A secret staircase leading downstairs will then open up where Dr.Merle is sitting. Go down the stairs and you'll enter a room with a large, mysterious-looking chamber. Determined to prove his DNS-siphoning theory is correct, Dr. Merle gets into the chamber– which soon begins to fill with liquid – and asks you to flush him. Press the red button on the control panel in front of the chamber to do so. Unfortunately, this puts the water authority on your case. They warn over a loudspeaker that the authorities are on their way and that the chamber is highly toxic, so you absolutely should not step inside it. Step inside the chamber and you'll automatically be flushed. You wake up (somehow) outside Jason's House with a notification telling you your max stamina has increased. © GamesRadar+. sources.text: Here’s how to complete Boobie Time in GTA 6 and what rewards the mission gives. GTA 6’s Boobie Time mission follows Jason help local adult “businessman” Boobie collect payments around the city.Â Â Here’s how to complete Boobie Time in GTA 6, including every mission objective, how to retrieve the stolen money and the rewards for completing the mission. Need more GTA 6 guides? Then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Boobie Time is a Chapter 3 story mission played as Jason. To unlock it, you must first complete the initial part of Dubious Provenance. Once that’s done, travel to the Jack of Hearts club in Crosstown as Jason and speak to Boobie to begin the mission. Follow Boobie outside the club and get into the driver’s seat of his car. Your first objective is to visit two separate collection points. Drive a few blocks south to the first location and wait for Boobie to finish speaking with the men in the parking lot. Next, head southwest towards the second collection point. Pull up beside the building and honk your horn by clicking the left stick. Once the collections are complete, drive south towards the city centre and stop beside the club near the river. After a cutscene talking to one of Boobie’s contact, you’ll discover that thieves have stolen the cash bag from Boobie’s car. Jason automatically jumps onto a jetski, allowing you to pursue the criminals along the river. Follow the thieves and shoot at them while chasing them through the waterways. Eventually, they’ll reach a dead end and begin circling around while firing back. You can take them out before then, at which point you’ll recover the bag and head back to Boobie. With the cash recovered, head back up the river and dismount the jetski near Boobie. Get back into his car and drive across the river to the nearby smoke shop. Follow Boobie inside, where he’ll introduce Jason to local businessman Yasmani. Yasmani is an essential NPC going forward, as from the end of this mission,Â you can sell a lot of items to Yasmani. Completing the mission unlocks Yasmani as a contact. Yasmani is particularly useful because he offers better prices than other drop-off locations for: You can still sell Narcotics to Yasmani, but you’ll get more cash for Narcotics from Tyrone. Completing this mission means you’ll also unlock access to Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, which provide additional opportunities to earn money.

sources.title: GTA 6 Top Billing walkthrough: How to complete the mission and rewards
sources.text: Wondering how to complete Top Billing in GTA 6? GTA 6’s Top Billing mission starts with Jason and Lucia joining budding music executive Dre’Quan for a night at the Jack of Hearts nightclub. Here’s how to complete Top Billing in GTA 6, including all mission objectives and rewards. We’re deep into our GTA 6 coverage. For everything you need to know abvoutÂ GTA 6, check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Top Billing becomes available after completing the Chapter 3 mission Car Service. Head to the Jack of Hearts nightclub in Crosstown after receiving Dre’Quan’s invitation. You can start the mission as either Jason or Lucia, but both characters will always be present on this mission. Once inside the nightclub, head down the hallway to the right of the stairs to find Dre’Quan backstage. After the cutscene, the game will control switch to Lucia. Head towards the front entrance of the club and speak to the host, who explains that the Real Dimez have been thrown out. Leave the club and head into the parking lot, where you’ll find Roxy and Bae arguing. When Roxy drives away, get into the nearby car with the rest of the group and follow her. This part of the mission is scripted, as no matter how much you keep up with her a passing train eventually blocks your route. Dre’Quan suggests stopping at Peewees for food instead. Head inside and order food for everyone at the counter. Make sure to Dre’Quan’s fries. This doesn’t really change much, but it’s just do it for a bit of chaos. Once the group finishes talking, return to Bae-Luxe’s car and drive towards the house party near the Vice City International Airport. Once you arrive, Lucia must enter the property alone through the crowd of people blocking the door. Once inside, you need to find Roxy in a back bedroom.Â You’ll encounter Jacki blocking the door leading to Roxy. Rather than trying to push past her, head around to the kitchen on the opposite side of the house. You’ll find Jacki’s dog scratching at a door. Open it to let the dog outside, distracting Jacki and allowing you to access the room. Inside, you’ll find Roxy talking to Kaamal. Wait for him to stand up before knocking him out with a melee attack. At this point, Lucia will try to convince Roxy to leave with her, Jason and the rest of the gang. The game will then switch control to Jason outside the property. Find the green electrical box on the street corner and open it. Look towards the left side of the box and interact with the switch to cut the power. Finally, switch back to Lucia and follow Roxy out of the house to complete Top Billing. Enjoy the show. There is no cash reward for Top Billing, and no special weapon reward.

sources.title: GTA 6 Mami Knows Best mission walkthrough
sources.text: Mami Knows Best is the fortieth mission in GTA 6. In the Mami Knows Best mission, Lucia reunites with her mother, Mia,Â as Mia shows off her new job. Things quickly go poorly. Here’s how to complete the Mami Knows Best mission in GTA 6, including all objectives and the rewards you can earn. Need more GTA 6 guides? Then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Mami Knows Best is a Chapter 3 story mission that can only be started when playing as Lucia. It becomes available after completing Dealer’s Choice as Jason and Lucia. Meet Lucia’s mum, Mia Caminos. After the initial conversation about Mia’s real estate business, get into her car and drive to her new property in Hamlet. Follow Mia inside the house and explore each room as she inspects the property. It’s an absolute wreck, and you may have noticed. Once you’ve finished looking around, return towards the entrance and help Mia up when prompted. Next, head outside and start clearing the front lawn. Pick up the rubbish and throw each item to the blue dumpster. After you do this a few times, the objective will change to help Mia in the backyard. Follow Mia around to the backyard, where you’ll find a mattress floating in the swimming pool. Interact with it and follow the button prompts to pull it out. Be ready for trouble, however. An alligator jumps out of the pool attacks Mia, grabbing her leg. Quickly pull out your weapon and shoot the animal to save her. If you fail to do this, Mia will be eaten, and the mission will fail. Use Focus Mode and target the red areas onÂ the alligator to ensure you kill it. After this, the M7 gang, who own the property, turn up. Following a confrontation with the gang, Mia decides to get even with her new neighbours. Cross the street and climb into the excavator. Drive it towards the gang’s property and start destroying the house and vehicles parked in the driveway. Most of the house is fully destructable, so I’d reccomend grabbing the roof and other bits that can be easly torn off. Don’t forget the cars.Â Keep causing damage until the objective updates. Once you’ve caused enough destruction, return to Mia’s car and get inside. Drive her to the office which is close to the neighbourhood, and that’s you done with Mami Knows Best. There is no cash payment, weapon or vehicle reward for completing this mission. Just a mother’s appreciation, which is priceless.

sources.title: Sex in GTA 6 was extremely difficult to pull off, Rockstar says
sources.text: Implementing sex into GTA 6 in a believable way was quite tricky to pull off, according to developer Rockstar Games . This being both a Grand Theft Auto game and a love story, it's not a shocker that sex and intimacy (and the most nudity I've ever seen in a video game) are so prominent in GTA 6. Getting the balance just right was pretty tough, however. "Exploring the physical relationship between Jason and Lucia required a lot of thought and iteration," Rockstar's vice president of animation, Mark Tennant, explains in quotes given to GamesRadar ahead of our GTA 6 review . "We needed to allow players to interact with the partner in a natural, loving way, with a believable progression based on their overall investment in the relationship," he adds. GTA 6's romance isn't a totally linear line. Jason and Lucia can be hotly passionate about each other or just be cordial partners in crime, depending on your choices, so how they interact physically needed to match their relationship status. "This required us to create animation performances that found a realistic balance between player agency and partner response while keeping things fun, passionate, and rewarding," Tennant says. It's a far cry from how many of the other games in the series dealt with sex, where your main interactions with romantic partners were impersonal and often transactional. On the flip side, GTA 6 is almost always making you consider someone outside of yourself and sex isn't just an awkward animation that plays if you drop some in-game cash. Jason and Lucia's central romance is the reason why Rockstar isn't letting you hire prostitutes this time around, too. Rockstar's latest open world has been a long time coming. sources.text: GTA 6 ’s sex scenes required careful animation work, Rockstar says, so physical interactions could reflect Jason and Lucia’s relationship. The relationship between GTA 6’s main characters takes center stage in the recently released title. While the romance elements can be ignored, Jason and Lucia’s connection can evolve into something even more intimate. In a new interview, Rockstar’s Mark Tennant explains why GTA 6’s intimacy animations balance choice, partner responses, and the resulting relationship between Jason and Lucia. Grand Theft Auto has previously let players pick up sex workers and invite strippers to their houses for private lap dances. GTA: San Andreas had the “Hot Coffee” mod. That was an infamous mod that unlocked hidden sexual content and intensified controversy around the game’s reputation. Still, this is the first time the gameplay has gone beyond that to building a relationship where intimacy actually matters. Speaking to GamesRadar+, Rockstar Games’ animation VP Mark Tennant explains why Jason and Lucia’s physical relationship in GTA 6 required extensive thought and iteration. “We needed to allow players to interact with the partner in a natural, loving way, with a believable progression based on their overall investment in the relationship,” he said. “This required us to create animation performances that found a realistic balance between player agency and partner response while keeping things fun, passionate, and rewarding.” Grand Theft Auto 6 is currently the best-reviewed game of all time . It’s also nominated for Game of the Year at the 2026 Game Awards. Insider Gaming will continue to monitor the story and report any updates as more information becomes available. sources.text: Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler – November 23 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency. Build. Optimize. Relax. The Spotter: Dig or Die – November 23 XBOX Play Anywhere You’re a Spotter, the unlucky soul stationed at the worst gas station in Nevada. Your mission: hold the line against mutant hordes spilling from the ruins of Las Veganos, while awaiting a message from the President himself. But when a colossal sandstorm wrecks the base and ruins your only receiver, you lose your one chance of contact. Now everything hinges on repairing it in time. Dig by day, fight by night, and reclaim the signal before the world’s last hope is lost. Descend into a mine to scavenge for resources, discover roguelike artifacts that rewrite the rules, and turn your rusty junkyard into an impenetrable fortress in this unique hybrid of digging simulator and Tower Defense. Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party – November 24 Grab your friends. Lift them over your head. Throw them off a pizza rooftop. Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match. Everyone is the same jelly body in a different costume. Be a Banana, a Shark, a Hot Dog, a Ghost or a Nightstand. Punch, kick and grab. Knock a fighter dizzy, carry them to the edge while the crowd chants, and let go. Master the art of auctions and score big against others for treasures in Storage Hunter Simulator ! Stay ahead of the competition in the high-risk, high-reward world of storage auctions. Showcase your skills, win intense bidding wars and sell your hard-earned valuables to customers. Getting the best deal and maximizing your earnings is key to staying in business and building a solid reputation. A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at the same time, navigating complex levels where every move is mirrored. It seems easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection? The forest has been invaded by slime creatures, and now it’s up to Bear to help the villagers reclaim their home! Get ready for an adventure filled with puzzles, sticky monsters, and slime explosions. Explore 40 puzzle levels where every move matters. Push slime balls through the environment, plan your moves carefully, and find the right way to eliminate all the Slime Monsters. Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s craziest aliens! Not every alien visits Earth to witness the indomitable human spirit. Some just want to chill on the Moon’s surface and play games. Born from the legendary internet meme, this isn’t just your average “friendslop” party game. Alien humor is… how should we put it… a bit of a brainrot. In this first-person, four-player, online multiplayer space adventure, every alien at the table must do whatever it takes to win in a variety of tabletop games. You’ll craft sneaky strategies, tell outrageous lies, pull hidden weapons, and literally blow up the heads of your so-called “friends.” Calculus of Rot – November 26 Smart Delivery The world is dead. Mutants roam the ruins, and every step forward could be your last. Explore dark, infected zones hidden beneath the fog of war. Reveal new paths, discover useful items, and carefully decide which enemies to confront. Every encounter costs resources, and every mistake brings you closer to death. Study enemy strength, plan your route, and use your limited health and attacks wisely. Some monsters are worth the risk. Others should be avoided at all costs. As you progress, stronger abominations begin to appear, turning each map into a deadly tactical puzzle where survival depends on smart decisions rather than luck. Full Metal Sergeant 2 – November 26 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere If you die on the battlefield, it’s not my fault. You think boot camp’s hard? Try surviving my camp. In Full Metal Sergeant 2 you’re a hellish instructor. Your mission is to transform raw recruits into specialized war machines. Mold their minds and bodies, instill discipline, and hone their combat skills. Gravity SWITCH – November 26 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks! Step into a high-stakes sliding maze where stopping isn’t an option. In this fast-paced arcade puzzler, once you push in a direction, you slide until a wall stops you. Plan your routes, collect all the dots, and activate the warp crystal to reach the next level – if you can survive the traps in your way. Machine Party – November 26 XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror. MANIC MINER – November 26 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere The legendary platforming classic is back! Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.
